name: Dark Matter
description: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his true family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

videos.title: Are You Happy in Your Life?
videos.overview: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

videos.title: Trip of a Lifetime
videos.overview: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense—he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

videos.title: The Box
videos.overview: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

videos.title: The Corridor
videos.overview: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

videos.title: Worldless
videos.overview: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

videos.title: Superposition
videos.overview: Daniela suspects something's not right with her husband. Jason and Amanda grow closer.

videos.title: In the Fires of Dead Stars
videos.overview: Jason and Amanda visit a breathtaking world. To hide the truth from Daniela, Jason2 takes desperate action.

videos.title: Jupiter
videos.overview: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

videos.title: Entanglement
videos.overview: The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

videos.title: A Quiet Life
videos.overview: The Dessens receive an unwelcome visitor. Ryan finds Amanda. Leighton finds himself.

videos.title: A Perfect World
videos.overview: The search for a new home starts again. Amanda and Ryan set off on a quest.

videos.title: Everything Beautiful, Everything Terrible
videos.overview: Jason’s fixation on the Box tests his marriage. Ryan and Amanda step into a world forever changed.

videos.title: Stars, Hide Your Fires
videos.overview: The Dessens reach their breaking point.

videos.title: Love and Be Loved
videos.overview: The story of a Jason who lost his family.

videos.title: What the Universe Is Made Of
videos.overview: Daniela meets someone from her past. Jason pursues his dream. Leighton unveils a new project.

videos.title: The Pyramid
videos.overview: Charlie meets a kind stranger. Blair gives Leighton a warning. Amanda and Ryan face an unknown horror.

videos.title: The Basic Oneness of Everything
videos.overview: As unexpected reunions unfold, Agent MacNamara sees for himself what the Box can do.

videos.title: How to Build the Box
videos.overview: Laurel discovers a new purpose after a shocking arrival shakes up her world.

videos.title: No Quiet Life
videos.overview: Season finale. A high-stakes gambit leads to unintended consequences.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 5 nominations total
